set.why: Selling out early every single day strongly suggests more people wanted croissants than were baked. Baking more next week might be a smart plan, but the passage does not say it will happen.

why: Old why said selling out 'means' demand was greater than supply; a sellout only shows demand at least met supply, so the claim was overstated. Softened to 'strongly suggests', matching the 'best supported' question.
